name: MLS Projection
aliases: MLS projection via Hermite Point Set Surfaces
definition: An iterative algorithm to project a query point onto a surface defined by a set of input points and normals, fitting a local quadratic function.
summary: MLS Projection is an iterative algorithm that projects points onto a smooth surface defined by noisy point clouds and normals, distinguishing itself by using weighted tangent plane projections and polynomial fitting rather than grid-based methods.
